title: Only one of the two bargains I struck (Fenmarch's water tithe) produced a later 'the price is due' callback ('After the Nave' at the Priory); the other (Thornwold's Company oath at the Gallows Glade) never resurfaced despite multiple later visits to Camp Gallows, so the 'walk back into town and someone raises the price' pattern wasn't consistently implemented.
